verdict.rationale: Appwrite's Storage product documents upload/download/delete/list file APIs plus a preview endpoint for resizing/cropping/transforming images, and Appwrite is widely known for permission-based access control across services, but the evidence pack does not explicitly document per-file access rules/permissions syntax or CDN-backed delivery for storage. missing for 10: explicit documentation of file-level access/permission rules, explicit CDN/edge-delivery claims for storage, independent/hands-on confirmation of serving performance.
